crossRefs.note: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down, that we may walk over…

translations.web: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
translations.bsb: The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.
translations.kjv: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
translations.asv: The plowers plowed upon my back; They made long their furrows.
